login.title: Sign in to MovieClaw
login.subtitle: Use your account on this server to sign in.
login.addSubtitle: Sign in to another account. Switch accounts later from the user menu without entering your password again.

accounts.loadFailed: Could not load accounts. Try again later.
accounts.switchFailed: Could not switch accounts. Try again later.
accounts.removeCurrentHint: This is the current account. Signing out removes its session from this browser and switches to another saved account. Enter the password again to return.
accounts.removeHint: This browser will no longer save its signed-in session. Enter the password again to return. The account itself is unchanged.
accounts.removeFailed: Could not remove account. Try again later.
accounts.hint: Select an account already signed in on this browser to switch without entering its password.
accounts.signOutAllHint: {count, plural, one {The account on this browser will be signed out. Enter its password again to return.} other {All # accounts on this browser will be signed out. Enter each password again to return.}} Recommended for shared devices.
accounts.limit: Up to {count, plural, one {# account can} other {# accounts can}} be saved at once. Remove one to add another.

startup.connection: Cannot connect to the server. Check that MovieClaw is running and that the address is correct.
startup.http: The server request failed (HTTP {status}). Check the server or reverse proxy configuration.
